text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Liamine Zeroual meets party leaders to discuss a cross-party committee to oversee parliamentary elections planned for this summer.
- A home-made bomb explodes near a tearoom in Ouel el Alleug in Blida province, wounding three people.
- Algeria starts talks with the European Union on an association deal.
- The authorities ration water supply in Algiers because of drought.
